dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the secret to being a winner?

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: You want to know how to be a winning card player? Alright, I'll tell you.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: The thing is, it's seventy percent skill, thirty percent luck...

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Now, thirty percent might not sound very much — but when your opponent's skills and your own are perfectly matched, that thirty percent luck is what decides who will win.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: There is just one exception to this... I've heard that there's a famously unlucky adventurer by the name of Bennett in Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: If luck's not on your side, it's hopeless, no matter how good your skills are.
